CREATE FUNCTION CDN.ECODDeliveryPointLines(@ZaNNumer int,@zan_frmnumer int)
RETURNS @DeliveryPoint TABLE ( PartyNameD varchar(350), BuyerDeliveryPoint varchar(13), StreetAndNumberD varchar(30), CityNameD varchar(30), PostalCodeD varchar(10), CountryD varchar(2), TelephoneNoD varchar(30), FaxNoD varchar(30) ) as BEGIN
insert into @DeliveryPoint select top 1 rtrim(ltrim(isnull(BuyerPoint.kna_nazwa1,'')))+rtrim(ltrim(isnull(BuyerPoint.kna_nazwa2,'')))+rtrim(ltrim(isnull(BuyerPoint.kna_nazwa3,''))) as PartyNameD, isnull(BuyerPoint.KnA_GLN,'-1') as BuyerDeliveryPoint, BuyerPoint.kna_ulica as StreetAndNumberD, BuyerPoint.kna_miasto as CityNameD, BuyerPoint.kna_kodP as PostalCodeD, BuyerPoint.kna_kraj as CountryD, BuyerPoint.kna_telefon1 as TelephoneNoD, BuyerPoint.kna_fax as FaxNoD from cdn.firma TP left outer join cdn.KntKarty as Buyer on TP.Frm_KntTyp=Knt_GIDTyp and TP.Frm_KntNumer=Knt_GIDNumer left join CDN.KntAdresy as BuyerPoint on Knt_GIDNumer=KnA_KntNumer and KnA_Wysylkowy=1 and isnull(kna_dataarc,0)=0 where TP.frm_gidtyp = 848 and TP.frm_gidnumer = @zan_frmnumer return
END
